{{top|leg}}
'''Weapon Supercharges''' are a type of weapon modification that can temporarily increase the rate of fire of any given weapon provided it is some sort of firearm. These usually come in the form of a [[Power cell/Legends|power cell]]<ref name="Dark Forces">''[[Star Wars: Dark Forces]]''</ref> or a [[Blaster gas canister/Legends|blaster gas canister]].<ref name="Dark Forces II">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''</ref> They have been known to work on [[Bryar pistol/Legends|Bryar pistols]], [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifles]], [[Imperial repeater rifle|Imperial Repeater Rifles]], [[Jeron fusion cutter|Jeron Fusion Cutters]], [[Packered mortar gun|Packered Mortar Guns]], [[Stouker concussion rifle|Stouker Concussion Rifles]], [[Assault cannon/Legends|Assault Cannons]],<ref name="Dark Forces" /> [[Bowcaster/Legends|Bowcasters]], and [[Rail detonator|Rail Detonators]].<ref name="Dark Forces II" />
